_meta.title: ClearStreak spiritual affirmations (864zeros-authored, derived from the Holy Bible, KJV, public domain)
_meta.policy: Each affirmation is original 864zeros writing — authored, not quoted — but is a faithful interpretation of one specific KJV verse and carries that verse's exact citation and text. Overtly faith-centered (this is the faith pillar, unlike the secular recovery set).
_meta.voice: Devotional, warm, second-person, poet's economy. Abstracted: each statement stands alone with only its own context plus its scripture reference. See _src/AFFIRMATIONS_STYLE.md.
_meta.source_format: Mirrors clearStreak-daily-verse.json.json: citation + verse_text (KJV, public domain).

affirmations.text: You are not carrying this alone. The same hand that holds the world is holding you up right now — so lift your head; you were never meant to be strong by yourself.

source.verse_text: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.

affirmations.text: Whatever today asks of you, you are not left to your own strength. You can do this — not because you are enough on your own, but because the One who strengthens you is.

source.verse_text: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

affirmations.text: Hand the worry over. Every anxious thing you're gripping can be set down in prayer — and a peace you can't explain will stand guard over your heart and mind.

source.verse_text: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

affirmations.text: Even here — in the valley, in the shadow — you do not walk alone. Fear loses its grip the moment you remember Who is beside you.

source.verse_text: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

affirmations.text: When the ground shakes, you have a refuge that doesn't. He is a very present help — not distant, not later, but here, now, in the trouble itself.

source.verse_text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

affirmations.text: Be still. You don't have to solve everything in this moment. Loosen your grip and remember: He is God, and you are held.

source.verse_text: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

affirmations.text: Be strong and take courage — not because the road is easy, but because you don't travel it alone. He goes with you wherever you go.

source.verse_text: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

affirmations.text: Cast the whole weight of it on Him — all of it, not just the tidy part. He is not too busy for your worry; He cares for you.

source.verse_text: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

affirmations.text: If you are worn down and heavy-laden, there is an open invitation with your name on it: come, and be given rest.

source.verse_text: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

affirmations.text: Tomorrow is not yours to carry yet. Set it down. Today has enough in it — and grace enough to meet it.

source.verse_text: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.

affirmations.text: Trust with your whole heart, even the parts that don't understand. You aren't required to have it all figured out — only to lean on the One who does.

source.verse_text: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

affirmations.text: In everything, acknowledge Him — the small turns and the large. Where you can't see the path, He can, and He will make it straight.

source.verse_text: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

affirmations.text: A broken heart doesn't push God away — it draws Him near. He is closest to the crushed, and He is close to you.

source.verse_text: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

affirmations.text: He heals the broken-hearted and binds up their wounds. Your hurt is not too deep for His mending.

source.verse_text: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

affirmations.text: Wait on Him and your strength is renewed. What feels spent in you is not the end of you — He gives you wings, second wind, and the strength to keep walking.

source.verse_text: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.

affirmations.text: You are not the sum of your old story. In Him you are made new — the old has passed, and something fresh has already begun in you.

source.verse_text: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.

affirmations.text: His mercies don't run out and they don't run low. Whatever yesterday held, this morning arrives new — great is His faithfulness toward you.

source.verse_text: It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

affirmations.text: Even this — the part that makes no sense — is being woven into good. You can't see the whole pattern yet, but the One weaving it can.

source.verse_text: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

affirmations.text: Nothing you face can cut you off from His love — not your failure, not your fear, not the depth you feel you've fallen. Nothing.

source.verse_text: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come, nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

affirmations.text: You can ask for a clean start from the inside out. He creates in you a clean heart and renews a right spirit — as many mornings as it takes.

source.verse_text: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.

affirmations.text: When you lift your eyes past the trouble, your help is already on the way. It comes from the Lord, the Maker of heaven and earth.

source.verse_text: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.

affirmations.text: If the Son sets you free, you are free indeed — not on parole, not on probation, but free. Live like it's true, because it is.

source.verse_text: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

affirmations.text: His grace is enough for you — especially where you feel weakest. Your weakness isn't disqualifying; it's exactly where His strength shows up.

source.verse_text: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness.

affirmations.text: The night of weeping is real, but it is not forever. Hold on — joy comes in the morning.

source.verse_text: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

affirmations.text: When you pass through deep water, He is with you, and it will not pull you under. When you walk through fire, it will not consume you.

source.verse_text: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.

affirmations.text: Stop rehearsing the old ruin. He is doing a new thing — even now it is springing up. Look for it.

source.verse_text: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

affirmations.text: The thoughts He holds toward you are thoughts of peace, not harm — to give you a future and a hope. You are not being written off.

source.verse_text: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.

affirmations.text: The Lord is your light and your strength. When He is your salvation, what is left for you to be afraid of?

source.verse_text: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

affirmations.text: Be strong; take courage. He will not fail you and He will not forsake you — that isn't just a hope, it's a promise.

source.verse_text: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

affirmations.text: Cast your burden on Him and He will sustain you. You were never meant to hold it up alone.

source.verse_text: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

affirmations.text: He leaves you a peace the world can't give and can't take. Let not your heart be troubled — you've been handed something steadier than your circumstances.

source.verse_text: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

affirmations.text: That hunger for something right and whole isn't a flaw — bring it to Him. Those who hunger and thirst for righteousness will be filled.

source.verse_text: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.

affirmations.text: He lifts you out of the pit, out of the miry clay, and sets your feet on solid rock. Your next step has ground under it now.

source.verse_text: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.

affirmations.text: This temptation is not unbeatable, and you are not the first to face it. He is faithful — with it He always makes a way out. Look for the door.

source.verse_text: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.

affirmations.text: Don't grow weary in doing good. The harvest comes in its season — so don't quit right before it breaks.

source.verse_text: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

affirmations.text: When you cry out, He hears — and He delivers. Your voice does not disappear into the dark.

source.verse_text: The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.

affirmations.text: He is a shield around you and the One who lifts your head. When you can't raise it yourself, He does it for you.

source.verse_text: But thou, O LORD, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.

affirmations.text: The Lord is good — a stronghold in the day of trouble. He knows the ones who take refuge in Him, and He knows you.

source.verse_text: The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.

affirmations.text: Let your soul wait quietly for God alone. From Him — not from all your striving — comes your rescue.

source.verse_text: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.

affirmations.text: He is in your midst, and He is mighty to save. Hear this: He rejoices over you — the God of everything delights in you.

source.verse_text: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.

affirmations.text: Let no one count you out. When you fall, you will rise again. When you sit in darkness, the Lord Himself will be your light.

source.verse_text: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the LORD shall be a light unto me.

affirmations.text: Even the righteous fall — seven times — and rise seven times. Falling is not your identity. Getting back up is.

source.verse_text: For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.

affirmations.text: The fear pressing on you is not from God. He gave you a spirit of power, of love, and of a sound mind. Take back the mind He gave you.

source.verse_text: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

affirmations.text: Come and rest in the shelter of the Most High. Say it out loud: He is my refuge and my fortress — and the shadow of the Almighty is over you.

source.verse_text: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.

affirmations.text: Fix your mind on Him and He keeps you in perfect peace. The steadiness you're missing comes from where your attention rests.

source.verse_text: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.

affirmations.text: In this world you will have trouble — He never pretended otherwise. But take heart: He has already overcome the world, and you stand on the winning side of that.

source.verse_text: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

affirmations.text: Come boldly — not timidly — to the throne of grace. Mercy is waiting there, and help that arrives right on time, in your time of need.

source.verse_text: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

affirmations.text: When your body and your heart give out, He does not. God is the strength of your heart and your portion forever — the part of you that cannot fail is Him.

source.verse_text: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

affirmations.text: He is able to do far more than you can ask or even imagine — and He works that power inside you. Don't shrink your prayers to the size of your doubt.

source.verse_text: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us.

affirmations.text: This day was made — handed to you on purpose. However it looks, there is something in it to be glad for. Rejoice; you are still here.

source.verse_text: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
